context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 15 verified the NEW email/password authentication system. Backend: POST /api/auth/login-email works with brute force protection (5 attempts, 15 min lockout). POST /api/auth/create-user requires admin role and validates password length (>=6 chars). PUT /api/users/{user_id}/password and /company work for admin. GET /api/users excludes password_hash and includes auth_type field. Frontend: Login page has dual login (email form + Google button). Users page shows 'Crear Usuario' button, 'Tipo Auth' column with Email/Clave or Google badges, and 'Clave' button for email-auth users only. Admin user seeded on startup from ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD env vars.

backend.login_endpoint: POST /api/auth/login-email - validates email/password, creates session, sets httpOnly cookie
backend.create_user_endpoint: POST /api/auth/create-user - admin only, validates password >=6 chars, checks duplicate email
backend.password_change_endpoint: PUT /api/users/{user_id}/password - admin only, validates password >=6 chars
backend.company_assign_endpoint: PUT /api/users/{user_id}/company - admin only, sets active_company_id and adds to company_ids
backend.brute_force: 5 failed attempts locks account for 15 minutes (stored in login_attempts collection)
backend.admin_seed: On startup, seeds admin user from ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD env vars

frontend.auth_type_display: Badge shows 'Email/Clave' or 'Google' based on user.auth_type
frontend.clave_button: Only shown for users with auth_type='email'
